PROC

NOT DB_PermaDefeated((CHARACTER)S_CRE_GuardianOfFaith_5144e2e8-fbd7-41b3-a6fb-f4cf5759cb95)

IF

AND
NOT QRY_SCL_Drider_CaravanBetrayedAndInCombat()

AND

NOT DB_Players((CHARACTER)S_Player_Gale_ad9af97d-75da-406a-ae13-7071c563f604)

PROC

CreateAtObject(BASE_BOOK_StoryUse_4d0f9f0f-8290-4d24-a05a-e66c878d974d,_Player,0,0,"",0,_Book)
